services.name: Walk on the Wall Side
services.desc: 2 Hours Ages 21+: $50 Ages 20 and under: $35 under 18 must be accompanied by guardian Take a guided tour along the Tchoupitoulas Art Corridor Mural Wall Project which represents the 300 year history of New Orleans told through a series of murals panels along the Tchoupitoulas Flood wall. Under the artistic direction of renowned New Orleans artist Jamar D. Pierre the mural is organized as an historical timeline beginning in the 1700s up until present day. Upon it's completion, the painting will be will be the longest mural in the United States at over a mile long. The project 2 Hours • Starting at $35

services.name: Bayou & Wildlife Alligator EcoTour
services.desc: Experience Coastal Louisiana like never before! About New Orleans only heated boat tour. Launching from 6301 Paris road, only 7 miles outside New Orleans, we explore the scenic and historic waters of Bayou Bienvenue, learning all there is to know about the past, present and future of its fragile and important ecosystem. Along the way, you will see the levees and storm surge barricades that protect the city as well as an array of wildlife that serve as guardians of Louisianas coastal marshlands. All of our boats are heated with see-through covers and restrooms on board. We allow alcoholic $50/person • 2 hour cruise • Private available • Bathroom onboard

services.name: Sunset Cocktail Cruise & Seafood Boil
services.desc: Seafood Culinary Experience with NOLA Pedal Barge Join us for an immersive Seafood Culinary Experience that delves into the rich coastal culture of Louisiana. This hands-on excursion offers an intimate look at the significance of our brackish estuaries to the commercial fishing and hospitality industries. The experience includes a 45-minute boat ride, an authentic cooking demonstration featuring locally caught blue crabs, a specialty cocktail class, and a delightful dining experience. ----- Itinerary; Dockside Demo: Upon arrival, the Captain will meet your group and take you to the dock's end Boat Cruise w/ Cocktails followed by Seafood Boil & Feast · 2.5 hours

services.name: Irish Channel Pedal Pub-Crawl Tour
services.desc: Not a BYOB Tour 2 Hours Private Tour: $700 About Experience the vibrant beer scene of the Irish Channel in New Orleans with Nola Bike Bar’s Brewery tour. Join us for a memorable two-hour adventure as we pedal our way through the neighborhood, making stops at several renowned breweries along the way. As you hop aboard our unique bike bar, you'll find yourself immersed in the energetic atmosphere of the Irish Channel, known for its rich history and thriving craft beer culture. Our knowledgeable and friendly tour guides will lead you to a carefully curated selection of breweries, A 14-person pedal tour of the vibrant Irish Channel bar scene!
